subject: error when applying inla on a grid dataset

messages.author: da509bd8f2d340da
messages.subject: error when applying inla on a grid dataset
parts:
Hi, 

I am trying to apply the inla on a grid dataset by the following codes, india.graph is the grid neighborhood matrix.

formula1 = Y ~ f(india.struct,model="besag",graph.file="/home/inla/raster/india.graph") +
               f(index,model="iid")
result1  =  inla(formula1,family="gaussian",data=indiatest,verbose=T)
, and it gives me the error, "Error: s[k] + offset >= 1L && s[k] + offset <= n is not TRUE". Did I used it incorrectly?

Thanks,
Jeff

messages.author: bbb9357156c132fe
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] error when applying inla on a grid dataset
parts:
Hi Jeff,
Assuming the right things are in india.struct (the ith component
should be the region that observation i is in), then your call appears
to be correct.

Can you send the graph file? There's a decent chance that there's
something wrong in that (that's the most common problem). You could
try to run inla.debug.graph(graph.file) on it and it may tell you
what's wrong.

Can you also check that you're using the newest version of INLA (run
inla.update(testing=TRUE))

Best,

Dan
